M3AAWG is a body that develop and publish recommendations, training and educational material to fight abuse with operational perspective. They published guidelines for email authentication, with includes DMARC. There they mention that policy p=none is a transitional state and should be p=reject where possible or p=quarantine otherwise. Furthermore, they advise the use of rua tags. They consider ruf optional because they "are neither sent by most receivers nor terribly useful to most domain owners". Released September 2020.

The PCI Security Standards Council (PCI SSC) is a global forum that brings together payments industry stakeholders to develop and drive adoption of data security standards and resources for safe payments worldwide. PCI SSC (through the data security standard, PCI DSS) created a document in June 2024 about data security standard, which includes anti-phishing mechanism. In the document they advise the use of DMARC to fight against phishing. Furthermore, the document mentions the use of DMARC is a requirement after march 31 2025. "This requirement is a best practice until 31 March 2025, after which it will be required and must be fully considered during a PCI DSS assessment."
